correctness.rationale: The endpoint data yield h(u_hat′−λu_hat)=−u_n z^4 v(v−1)(vz+v−2)/6. For Re z<0, writing B=−vz and A=2−v gives 0<Re(B/(A+B))<1; differentiation under the strictly positive integral yields 4<ν_p<5 for every finite p. At z=−1+i√w, exact R polynomial arithmetic gives |R|²−1=[w(w−3)^2−32]/36; the unique w>3 root lies between 53/10 and 11/2. Exact μ=Re(zR′/R)=(w−1)^2(w−2)/12 > 5+339/4000. The determinant of the 2×2 feedback Jacobian equals 1+(βκ′(1)/4)(μ−ν_p)>1 for every positive gain and limiter slope; continuity gives a nonempty open boundary arc. Independent sympy rational arithmetic checked the root enclosure, μ lower bound and polynomial identities. Representative script tests at p=1,2,4 are corroboration only.
